title: Sesame-Ginger Tossed Salad with Edamame, Mango, Cabbage & Almonds

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the lettuce.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; add to the bowl.
Add shredded cabbage, almonds, and dressing to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with avocado and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
